التهمتا (form VIII)
# اِلْتَهَمَتَا (iltahamatā) /il.ta.ha.ma.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
# اُلْتُهِمَتَا (ultuhimatā) /ul.tu.hi.ma.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِلْتَهَمَ (iltahama)
